Coverage measures how completely NAMRIA polygons were enriched with canonical **PSGC codes**.
The headline figure for snapshot `2023-10-24` is **99.945% PSGC ↔ NAMRIA pcode match**.

## Coverage by level

| Level                 | File            | Features | Matched | Coverage |
|-----------------------|-----------------|---------:|--------:|---------:|
| ADM0                  | `adm0.geojson`  | 1        | 1       | 100.000% |
| ADM1 Region           | `adm1.geojson`  | 17       | 17      | 100.000% |
| ADM2 Province         | `adm2.geojson`  | 88       | 88      | 100.000% |
| ADM3 Municipality/City| `adm3.geojson`  | 1,626    | 1,624   | 99.877%  |
| ADM4 Barangay         | `adm4.geojson`  | 41,825   | 41,803  | 99.947%  |

Per-class extracts (hierarchical) split cities by class (highly urbanized, independent component,
component) and separate special geographic areas.

## Known gaps

::: {.callout-warning}

- ~198 PSGC barangays (mostly in BARMM and Metro Manila) — and ~230 PSGC entities in total — have
  no NAMRIA polygon.

- 6 features could not be resolved to a PSGC entity (`unresolved.geojson`).
- 1 component city (City of Isabela, Basilan) has no NAMRIA polygon.
:::

For how match confidence (`exact` / `huc_map` / `fuzzy`) is assigned, see
[feature properties](properties.qmd) and the [HUC mapping](../references/huc-mapping.qmd) reference.
